thread:
rachel: quick alert saw a queue spike during MIG-1301 canary backfill — many UPDATEs queued behind ALTER on shard 7. Holding the midnight window?

tom: yep saw a stacking wait_event on pg_stat_activity. link to short logs: https://staging/logs/1301

jamie: recommend we pin a mitigated worker build MIG-1301-patchA (BATCH=200, CONCURRENCY=2) and add a deploybot tourniquet rule to auto-pause if lock_count>3/5m.

mike: agree. rollback triggers: any single lock >240s OR 20%+ error spike across canary after patch.

deploybot: Action: adding pinned_version="MIG-1301-patchA" for 00:00-05:00 UTC; tourniquet rule set. Will auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall.

ci-bot: CI green for patchA: artifacts https://ci/1301/patchA run_id=run-1301-20260326-01

rachel: ops plan: 1) pause backfill workers on canary hosts 2) deploy patchA to 2 canary shards 3) monitor lockwatch + p99 for 25m 4) if stable -> continue phased rollout; unpin at 05:00

tom: updating infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json to include pinned_version and brief release note.

jamie: started deploy to canary. pausing high concurrency jobs.

rachel: after 18m canary stable, no long locks, p99 steady. lifting HOLD and proceeding but keeping pin until 05:00.

mike: filing follow-up: improve backfill-sim to mimic ALTER+concurrent UPDATEs. attach run_id to release notes.

ci-bot: reminder: attach run_id to audit: run-1301-20260326-01

rachel: thanks all, closing this thread unless regressions appear.
